name: Rapid Outbound Socket Burst (Potential Port Scan / Exfil)
description: Detects a single process opening more than 20 outbound sockets within a 15-second window.
explanation: High velocity outbound socket creation is characteristic of port sweeping, horizontal network discovery, or multi-threaded data exfiltration.
investigation_steps: Identify the PID and binary responsible for the connection burst.
Determine whether the target destinations are internal subnet IPs or external IPs.
Check if the binary is an authorized enterprise scanner or unauthorized utility.
